newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EVN top loser in Vienna after results.
newsitem.headline: EVN top loser in Vienna after results.

text.p: Shares in regional Austrian utility EVN were the top decliner in Vienna on Tuesday, slipping 4.33 percent after the firm reported a flat net profit for 1995/6 and lower than expected pre-tax earnings.
At 1011 GMT Energieversorgung Niederoesterreich shares were 67 schillings down at 1,480.
"The market was obviously expecting more. The firm had flagged 1995/6 would be a very good year so the flat net profit was a bit of a surprise," said a trader.
EVN pre-tax profit jumped 24 percent to a record 1.484 billion schillings. Nevertheless it was below analysts' expectations of around 1.5-1.7 billion schillings.
Net profit was steady at 667 million schillings due to a big rise in tax payments.
"EVN had risen strongly recently in expectation of a good set of results. These figures have taken the wind out of its sails," a trader said.
Over the past month EVN shares had advanced 11 percent in a stagnant market. -- Janet McBride, Vienna Newsroom 43-1-531 12 254
